description: Design, build, or refactor websites in the Signal News Intelligence language, derived from the public-facing MyAINewsBot design system. Use for turn a feed into an instrument panel: one dominant briefing, visible source spread, bias context, and a temporal signal trace. Includes narrative guidance, design tokens, page structure, a responsive static starter, safe scaffolding, and publication checks. Adapt the system to the user's brand instead of cloning names, logos, copy, or proprietary content.
